svg.aria-label: FractalSwarm. Kill half the brains. It still finishes. A tree of ten coordinators loses five of them, the root three times over. Each time a survivor inherits the work, and the recorded run ends with 48 of 48 talks placed.

g.text: A RUNTIME FOR TEAMS OF LLM AGENTS
48 of 48 talks placed · 0 hard violations · replay MATCH
